query: data, emnlp, john x morris
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND (
        (p.title ILIKE '%data%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%data%')
        OR a.name ILIKE '%john x morris%'
      )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN a.name ILIKE '%john x morris%' THEN 1
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%data%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%data%' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adaptation%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%domain%'

  p.title,

    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%concreteness%' AND p.title ILIKE '%subjectivity%' AND p.title ILIKE '%lexical%' AND p.title ILIKE '%meaning%' THEN 2
    WHEN a.name ILIKE '%felix hill%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
